final_answer:
Four high-risk user requirements are not currently verified. I counted a requirement as high-risk if any linked risk item is HIGH, either in a functional risk assessment (FRA) or in the process FMEA (pFMEA). I counted it as verified only if its test case, or the downstream spec it traces to, has a passing execution that is still valid.

| Requirement | Why it is not verified |
|---|---|
| **URS-INC-004** (door-open alarm within 60 s) | TC-OQ-INC-04 failed on incubator INC-03. The alarm activated at 142 s against a limit of 60 s (exec TX-0023, deviation DEV-26-011). The deviation is closed, but its impact assessment says "INC-03 door alarm function not verified". The fix, CC-26-019 (door switch replacement and re-execution of TC-OQ-INC-04 on INC-03), is "APPROVED - NOT IMPLEMENTED", so no passing re-test exists. The OQ report was approved with this exception. |
| **URS-EBR-009** (reject target MOI outside 4.0–6.0 TU/cell) | This requirement traces only to CS-EBR-03, the MOI hard-stop range-check configuration. No test case verifies CS-EBR-03 or the requirement, and none of the EBR OQ tests covers the MOI range check. It is linked to the HIGH pFMEA items FM-05 and FRA-042. |
| **URS-EMS-014** (escalate unacknowledged critical alarms by SMS and voice within 15 min) | It traces to CS-EMS-03 (notification groups and escalation), which TC-OQ-EMS-04 verified on 2026-01-20. CC-26-011 then rebuilt the notification groups and escalation recipients on a new paging provider (implemented 2026-03-16). That change was judged "no re-testing required", and no escalation test was run afterwards. The earlier pass no longer covers the current configuration. |
| **URS-CRF-001** (freezing profile CRF-P01 within ±2 °C with a representative load) | The only linked test, TC-OQ-CRF-01, ran in an empty chamber. There is no controlled-rate freezer PQ protocol, only IQ and OQ, so the representative-load part of the requirement has no verification. |

The other high-risk requirements have passing evidence. Examples are URS-INC-001, URS-INC-003, URS-ULT-001 and URS-ULT-002, the EBR, LIMS and PRDG items, and URS-LOVO-002. URS-EBR-001, URS-EMS-011, URS-EMS-012, URS-LIMS-002, URS-LIMS-003 and URS-LIMS-004 are verified through their traced CS, FS or DS items.

One item is borderline and not on the list. URS-PRDG-002 requires a CD3 purity of at least 90%. Its only test, TC-OQ-PRDG-02, checks program lock and version display, not purity. I treated it as verified, but it is worth a look.

Four high-risk user requirements are not currently verified. I counted a requirement as high-risk if any linked risk item is HIGH, either in a functional risk assessment (FRA) or in the process FMEA (pFMEA). I counted it as verified only if its test case, or the downstream spec it traces to, has a passing execution that is still valid.

| Requirement | Why it is not verified |
|---|---|
| **URS-INC-004** (door-open alarm within 60 s) | TC-OQ-INC-04 failed on incubator INC-03. The alarm activated at 142 s against a limit of 60 s (exec TX-0023, deviation DEV-26-011). The deviation is closed, but its impact assessment says "INC-03 door alarm function not verified". The fix, CC-26-019 (door switch replacement and re-execution of TC-OQ-INC-04 on INC-03), is "APPROVED - NOT IMPLEMENTED", so no passing re-test exists. The OQ report was approved with this exception. |
| **URS-EBR-009** (reject target MOI outside 4.0–6.0 TU/cell) | This requirement traces only to CS-EBR-03, the MOI hard-stop range-check configuration. No test case verifies CS-EBR-03 or the requirement, and none of the EBR OQ tests covers the MOI range check. It is linked to the HIGH pFMEA items FM-05 and FRA-042. |
| **URS-EMS-014** (escalate unacknowledged critical alarms by SMS and voice within 15 min) | It traces to CS-EMS-03 (notification groups and escalation), which TC-OQ-EMS-04 verified on 2026-01-20. CC-26-011 then rebuilt the notification groups and escalation recipients on a new paging provider (implemented 2026-03-16). That change was judged "no re-testing required", and no escalation test was run afterwards. The earlier pass no longer covers the current configuration. |
| **URS-CRF-001** (freezing profile CRF-P01 within ±2 °C with a representative load) | The only linked test, TC-OQ-CRF-01, ran in an empty chamber. There is no controlled-rate freezer PQ protocol, only IQ and OQ, so the representative-load part of the requirement has no verification. |

The other high-risk requirements have passing evidence. Examples are URS-INC-001, URS-INC-003, URS-ULT-001 and URS-ULT-002, the EBR, LIMS and PRDG items, and URS-LOVO-002. URS-EBR-001, URS-EMS-011, URS-EMS-012, URS-LIMS-002, URS-LIMS-003 and URS-LIMS-004 are verified through their traced CS, FS or DS items.

One item is borderline and not on the list. URS-PRDG-002 requires a CD3 purity of at least 90%. Its only test, TC-OQ-PRDG-02, checks program lock and version display, not purity. I treated it as verified, but it is worth a look.
